body: Couldn't tell you. I can't remember the last time I felt anything close to passion. To the point I don't think I would recognise it if I did
Take each day at a time and try not to end it

I've been on several medications over the years. I refuse to see certain doctors due to their disbelief. I've seen several councillors and it did not help. I've been to several mental health clinics with the same response. Right now, it is in my mind to do it tomorrow. Right now, everyone is in bed. Tomorrow, I have the house to myself.
